queries.text: Why did Nvidia's market value cross $4 trillion in July 2025, and what does the milestone say about AI infrastructure spending?
Nvidia's total market capitalization on the day it first exceeded $4 trillion in July 2025, measured in US dollars
Number of Nvidia shares outstanding as of July 2025 and corresponding share price per unit
Percentage change in Nvidia's stock price from January 1, 2024 to the date its market cap crossed $4 trillion in July 25
Total global AI infrastructure spending forecast for fiscal year 2025 by major analyst firms such as Gartner or IDC, measured in billions of USD
Share of Nvidia's revenue derived from data center GPUs compared to gaming GPUs for the most recent reported quarter prior to July 2025
Year-over-year percentage growth rate of hyperscaler capital expenditure on AI servers announced by Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and Meta for Q1 2025
Number of Blackwell architecture GPU units shipped by Nvidia in the first half of 2025 versus Hopper architecture shipments in the same period
Average annualized total addressable market (TAM) estimate for generative AI infrastructure hardware cited in Nvidia investor presentations during 2024-2025
